You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

Based on the chest radiographs provided, identify the type of Azygos Lobe present in this patient and justify your answer based on the morphology of the azygos fissure and the position of the trigonum parietale. 
A. Type A: The trigonum parietale is located in the lateral aspect of the pulmonary apex.
B. Type B: The mesoazygos has a vertical path.
C. Type C: The trigonum is located medially.
D. The azygos fissure is C-shaped indicating a large lobe.
E. The azygos fissure is straight or slightly undulated indicating a small lobe.
F. The presence of the Azygos Lobe cannot be confirmed from the X-ray.
